headline: What Clients Say
subheadline: Feedback from people I’ve had the pleasure of working with.

reviews.name: Dr. Martin Stoykov
reviews.review: Marko built the Deflamax site from scratch and the result was beyond what I expected. It's clean, fast, and people can easily find the product and how to order. He was professional and communicative throughout the entire process.

reviews.name: Momchil
reviews.review: Plenty needed a site that brings people to the shop, not one that tries to sell from the phone. Marko got that from the first conversation. Customers can now see where we are, when we're open and what they'll find, and I update the photos and collections myself. Clean, clear, and I don't have to message him for every new piece.
